notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creature tokens.
description:
Cast Ashling's Command by paying {U}{R} due to Magnus the Red. Choose its fourth mode targeting yourself and then any other mode as desired.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {R}{R} due to Magnus the Red, copying Ashling's Command with the fourth mode targeting yourself and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Ashling's Command, creating two Treasure tokens and performing the action of the other chosen mode.
Holding priority, activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
